description: pop and min on an empty stack return nothing
a single element is both the top and the minimum
descending pushes make every value a new minimum
ascending pushes keep the first value as the minimum
duplicate minimums survive a single pop
the minimum can sit in the middle of the stack
draining to empty then refilling resets the minimum
interleaved pushes and pops track the minimum mid-stream
i32 bounds are handled without overflow
a repeated minimum at the bottom stays the minimum until it is popped
longer mixed sequence with a late new minimum
deep descending run of 300 pushes makes every push a new minimum
deep ascending run of 300 pushes keeps a single minimum for the whole stack
